run_gtest_help_test_with_flag: run the gtest_help_test_ binary with a given command-line flag and return exit code and output
test_help_flag_behavior: test that gtest prints the correct help message when --help -h -? or /? is passed
test_non_help_flag_behavior: test that gtest runs tests normally and does not print help when no help flag is specified
test_incorrect_flag_variants: test that gtest prints help when incorrect flag styles like single dash or forward slash are used
test_internal_flag_behavior: test that gtest runs tests without printing help when an internal flag prefixed with internal_ is supplied
